learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic concepts of data processing, engineering informatics and digitalization and can apply them safely.
Understand the basic principles of data processing and can consider them when finding a solution.
Be able to develop a program in a higher-level programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Python).
Be able to effectively use language constructs (e.g., branching, loops, class definitions, variable declarations) of this programming language.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of engineering informatics and digitalization technology, such as presentation and processing of information in computers
Knowledge of the basic principles of data processing (fundamentals), such as number representations and arithmetic, computer networking
Gaining proficiency in using computers (application), through the use of advanced development environments according to industry standards
Insight into the various application areas of computers (factual knowledge)
Fundamentals of algorithmics (fundamentals, methodology and application), i.e., learning the procedure for designing a computer program to solve a given task

Introduction to programming (fundamentals, methodology and application), i.e., learning the procedure for implementing a computer program design in a specific programming language through the effective use of control structures, arrays and classes or objects (fundamentals, methodology and application)
